scope: Public JSON input structure only. Required/default values describe the reviewed build; referenced objects and geometry must also be valid. Older packaged builds may differ.
conventions: Numeric values are finite; use JSON true/false for booleans, not 0/1.
Names and capitalization are exact; do not add undocumented keys.
An optional parameter without an explicit default may acquire command-specific behavior; omission is not a universal default.
Objects described without members are extensible public payloads; consult the matching user guide or a shipped example.
